Frenchman's Bay Jamaica by rental car: how to get there, what to do nearby and how to book.

Frenchman's Bay. Sand, sea, your pace. 🌴

A St. Elizabeth beach worth the drive. Pick up your car and make a day of it.

Hills, villages and views you cannot see from a resort. Your own car means your own timetable.

Getting there: Pick up at Kingston, Norman Manley, Montego Bay offices, MBJ or OCJ and choose a road.

Leave room for roadside stops. Waterfalls, beaches, jerk and coffee are all a drive away.
